Start: Emeria Shepherd (battlefield); World Shaper (battlefield); Zuran Orb (battlefield); Bloodflow Connoisseur (battlefield)

  Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing World Shaper.

  Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
  Repeat
Notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. Produces: Infinite artifact tokens; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite self-mill; Infinite lifegain triggers; Infinite lifegain; Infinite landfall triggers; Return all nonland permanents from your graveyard to the battlefield; Infinite Blood tokens
Start: Emeria Shepherd (battlefield); World Shaper (battlefield); Zuran Orb (battlefield); Shilgengar, Sire of Famine (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
Steps: Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
  Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
  Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing World Shaper.
  When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
  Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
  Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
  Repeat
Notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. Cards: Preston, the Vanisher + Viscera Seer + Fiend Hunter + Chord of Calling
Color identity: WBG | Bracket: Spicy | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {3}{G}{G}{G} at most
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature tokens; Infinite death triggers; Infinite recursion of creature cards in your graveyard; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite scry 1
Start: Preston, the Vanisher (battlefield); Viscera Seer (battlefield); Fiend Hunter (library); Chord of Calling (hand)
Steps: Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
  When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
  Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
  Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
  When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
  Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
  When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
